facts.fact: The #KeepItOn coalition states that after protests following the 29 June 2024 election, authorities disrupted mobile internet for 22 days from 2 July to 24 July 2024, shutting down Mattel and Chinguitel, which a government spokesperson reportedly justified as necessary for security.

MRT.note: Earlier 2023 mobile blocks are named without exact dates.
The document concerns internet shutdowns and states nothing on police station records.
The document is an advocacy letter by coalition members and names no local research institution doing digital policy research.
